grading: confirmed = loaded and read on as_of; inferred = from a secondary source or platform knowledge, not loaded
primary_route: Community topic tagged 'Feature Request' plus a product tag, in the matching category. Supplied by the user 2026-10-21 and confirmed against live topics (e.g. developers-69/...-25530).

community.platform: Gainsight Customer Communities (formerly inSided); migrated from Khoros on 2026-07-02. Before that Vanilla.
community.account: Separate community account (/member/register, /member/login). Not the 1Password account. No 2FA/passkeys. Accounts migrated from the old forum need a password reset.

home.for: Personal and family plans, desktop/mobile apps, browser extension

work.for: Business/Teams, admin console, provisioning, Extended Access Management

developers.for: op CLI, SSH agent, SDKs, Connect, service accounts, shell plugins, integrations

community.tags: Always 'Feature Request' plus a product tag. Tags shown on the at-home new-topic page (confirmed 2026-10-21): Browser Extension, macOS, Windows, iOS, Betas, Android, CLI, Feature Request, Linux, Non-Technical Question. The picker autocompletes other existing tags.
community.new_topic_form: Confirmed 2026-10-21 by posting topic 25878: topic type radio (Question default / Conversation), title input, CKEditor 4 body (editor1), category select preset by ?fid=, tag autocomplete + suggested chips, Create button redirects to the topic.

machine_readable.sitemap: confirmed: one file, ~25.8k topic URLs with lastmod; slugs are titles
machine_readable.topic_json_ld: confirmed: QAPage JSON-LD with name, text (opening post), dateCreated, author, upvoteCount, answerCount. Replies and tags are not in it.
machine_readable.search: confirmed: /search renders client-side; a plain fetch gets no results. Use the browser.

community.ideas_board: https://www.1password.community/ideas exists but holds 0 ideas (confirmed). Do not post there.
community.voting: Like button on posts. Staff have said they do not prioritise by votes; requests are logged internally (inferred: Productboard, reference numbers like 'PB-49568927').
